history.summary: A 1978 freehold 4BR at Windy Heights (D14 Eunos/Kembangan), a huge 2,476 sqft unit at $3.58M / $1,446 psf, with a 5.05%/yr URA CAGR (19 txns). The 47-year-old building, $3.58M quantum, and very low score_1000 (155) outweigh the freehold-en-bloc angle for a 5-7yr investment hold.
history.rating_rationale: score_1000 of 155 is the batch's lowest and is justified: a 1978 (47-year-old) building carries heavy maintenance/obsolescence and harder financing, the $3.58M quantum is well above the liquid band, and the 2,476 sqft size makes the low PSF a size artefact (not cheap). The 5.05%/yr URA rate (19 txns) and freehold/en-bloc optionality are the bull case, but en-bloc is speculative and slow. For a defined 5-7yr investment hold, the age, quantum, and illiquidity make this an Avoid.

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: A 2,476 sqft 4BR in a dated 1978 block rents to families wanting space but at low gross yield; the ageing facilities limit tenant appeal at the high quantum.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: The 5.05%/yr rate is partly an en-bloc/scarcity premium on freehold land; absent a redevelopment event, an ageing large-quantum unit is more likely to lag on a fixed 5-7yr horizon.
